sentences.text: The carbon cycle is a part of the biogeochemical cycle where carbon is exchanged among the biosphere, pedosphere, geosphere, hydrosphere, and atmosphere of Earth.

relativeClauses.text: where carbon is exchanged among the biosphere, pedosphere, geosphere, hydrosphere, and atmosphere of Earth

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“The carbon cycle”，再看句法中心“is”。再读与中心词连接的宾语或补语候选“a part of the biogeochemical cycle where carbon is exchanged among the biosphere, pedosphere, geosphere, hydrosphere, and atmosphere of Earth”，确认动作对象或说明内容。留意连接标记“and”；回到原句判断它连接的是词语、短语还是分句。解析器标出的定语从句候选是“where carbon is exchanged among the biosphere, pedosphere, geosphere, hydrosphere, and atmosphere of Earth”；先读被修饰的名词，再回看这部分补充说明。检测到被动结构标记；注意区分承受动作的人或事物与动作发出者。

objectsOrComplements.text: the main component of biological compounds as well as a major component of many rocks such as limestone

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“Carbon”，再看句法中心“is”。再读与中心词连接的宾语或补语候选“the main component of biological compounds as well as a major component of many rocks such as limestone”，确认动作对象或说明内容。留意连接标记“as”；回到原句判断它连接的是词语、短语还是分句。

sentences.text: The carbon cycle comprises a sequence of events that are key to making Earth capable of sustaining life.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: a sequence of events that are key to making Earth capable of sustaining life

relativeClauses.text: that are key to making Earth capable of sustaining life

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干是 The carbon cycle comprises a sequence of events。that are key to ... 修饰 events；be key to 中的 to 是介词，后接 making。making Earth capable of sustaining life 是“使地球能够维持生命”的宾语加补语结构，不是以 Earth 为主语的独立从句。

sentences.text: It describes the movement of carbon as it is recycled and reused throughout the biosphere, as well as long-term processes of carbon sequestration (storage) to and release from carbon sinks.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: as it is recycled and reused throughout the biosphere, as well as

sentences.readingHintZh: It 指碳循环。describes 后有两项内容：the movement of carbon 与 long-term processes ...，由 as well as 连接。as it is recycled and reused throughout the biosphere 说明碳循环利用时的运动，到 biosphere 结束；不要把后面的 as well as 并入这个从句。

sentences.text: At 422.7 parts per million (ppm), the global average atmospheric carbon dioxide has set a new record high in 2024.

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“the global average atmospheric carbon dioxide”，再看句法中心“set”。把中心词与助动词、否定词或小品词一起读：“has”、“set”；这些词在原句中不一定连续。再读与中心词连接的宾语或补语候选“a new record”，确认动作对象或说明内容。

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“a distinction”，再看句法中心“made”。把中心词与助动词、否定词或小品词一起读：“can”、“be”、“made”；这些词在原句中不一定连续。留意连接标记“and”；回到原句判断它连接的是词语、短语还是分句。从句或非谓语补充部分候选为“To describe the dynamics of the carbon cycle”；先读主句，再核对各部分与中心词的关系。检测到被动结构标记；注意区分承受动作的人或事物与动作发出者。

sentences.text: Fast cycles can complete within years, moving substances from atmosphere to biosphere, then back to the atmosphere.

subordinateClauses.text: moving substances from atmosphere to biosphere, then back to the atmosphere

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“Fast cycles”，再看句法中心“complete”。把中心词与助动词、否定词或小品词一起读：“can”、“complete”；这些词在原句中不一定连续。从句或非谓语补充部分候选为“moving substances from atmosphere to biosphere, then back to the atmosphere”；先读主句，再核对各部分与中心词的关系。

sentences.text: Slow or geological cycles (also called deep carbon cycle) can take millions of years to complete, moving substances through the Earth's crust between rocks, soil, ocean and atmosphere.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: to complete, moving substances through the Earth's crust between rocks, soil, ocean and atmosphere

sentences.readingHintZh: 主语是 Slow or geological cycles，括号内 also called deep carbon cycle 补充名称；谓语是 can take。take millions of years to complete 说明完成所需时间，moving ... 是补充说明物质运动的分词短语。不要因为句首 Slow 被误识别而漏掉主语。
